ValidationRule.description: Flight record can't be edited when the case origin is 'QAC Website'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.Name == 'Service Request', AND(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Origin, 'QAC Website'),Case__r.IsClosed == false),OR( ISCHANGED( Name ),ISCHANGED( Salutation__c ),ISCHANGED( Passenger_Type__c ),ISCHANGED( New_Salutation__c ),ISCHANGED( Date_of_Birth__c ),ISCHANGED( QAC_Flight_Number__c ),ISCHANGED( New_Last_Name__c ),ISCHANGED( New_First_Name__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit the Passenger record if Case Origin is 'QAC Website'.
